decision: Every dot is generated from the build-vs-buy JSON, and a test checks each dot sits in the quadrant its decision names
why: A map drawn by hand drifts from the cards the day one row changes.
value: The map can never disagree with the cards.

decision: Two plain axes: how much it makes us different, how hard it is to do well
why: Anyone can place a component on those two questions without knowing the technology.
value: The founder can argue with the placement, which is the point.

decision: Dots carry A or B inside them in the problem's color; no legend
why: A legend is one more thing to decode on a shared screen.
value: Readable at a glance, and without color.

decision: Four questions decide every dot: why customers choose us, hard and generic, swappable later, cost at 10×
why: The same questions applied to every component make choices comparable and reviewable.
value: A small team spends its time where it makes a difference.

decision: A build-later quadrant: start with a ready tool, own it once there is data
why: Building what differentiates too early wastes months; buying it forever gives the edge away.
value: Time is spent where it pays, when it pays.
